<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Voter enrollment challenge:</strong> The Supreme Court is reviewing a plea challenging the Election Commission&#x27;s directive that requires deleted Delhi voters to re-enroll under the new SIR system.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTE5uX0FaNUk3ZThrZDZfb0t5Yk5nYVRnbDhXOW5ScmNZNVhtUlgwUkRRV0hIVmVkMHBGUlNKZllPbV9zcWQ0d2dYY0lQakZQalloenNfN2NHTnF0UWk3UkJTbk9pMy16U3M0?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Protest conduct petition:</strong> A legal challenge has been filed in the Supreme Court regarding the gathering of Rahul Gandhi and other INDIA bloc leaders within restricted premises.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Municipal election results:</strong> The BJP has retained control of the GMC by securing 38 seats, while the Congress saw gains and the AAP failed to win any seats.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Protest pause:</strong> The INDIA bloc has temporarily suspended its daily marches in Delhi against the SIR system and the CEC due to the ongoing festive season.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a></span></li>
</ul>
